name: Liquid Stone
label: Quest
description: Liquid Stone: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm thinking those items you acquired for Lotwil are going to be the least of our worries, friend. On the other hand, you've proven more than adept at the sciences Lotwil holds sacred, so how about helping me out?
I need an invisibility potion and a healing potion; both might come in handy real soon if he pulls this off.
In return, I'll give you this recipe for a potion I've been developing while learning from Lotwil. It's based on some of the research he's been doing here in the Badlands.

clips.title: Progress
paras: He's getting closer to finishing. How are things going on your end?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I mean, thank you, friend. These will be helpful while traveling through the Badlands.
